description: This file is a shell script used for testing rename interactions and copy detection in a Git repository. It sets up test environments, runs various Git diff commands with copy and rename detection options, and compares expected outputs to actual diffs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines and runs a successful test block, verifying the commands succeed.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the current diff output with an expected output.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with the specified exit code.
